sources.actual_use: Theorem D' is applied with h=2/3 after the final marginal inequality gives alpha_i<=0.6221367205, yielding 9 sqrt(3e)(a1 a2 B)^(-1/3).
Final-matrix marginal bound and sharp collective-tail Fourier constant 9 sqrt(3)e/2.
Partner sharp scalar-Schur compiler propagates a terminal B/L cap through arbitrary-length original-coordinate pivot chains when each |a_j|>=(4/B)L.

results.statement: For an original-coordinate cross block M=M0+L+E, max diag(P)<=1/2, rank L<=r, (I-P)L=0 and ||E||op<=delta, define a1=(s_{r+1}(M0)-delta)_+, a2=(s_{r+2}(M0)-delta)_+, B^2=sum_{k>=r+3}(s_k(M0)-delta)_+^2, epsilon0=||(I-P)M0||op. If a2,B>0 and epsilon0+delta<=B/15, then ||p_Q||inf<=(9 sqrt(3)e/2)(a1 a2 B)^(-1/3), with arbitrary self/outside blocks.

For the m=1024 Hadamard cross family with singular values 2,2,2,0.04,..., a literal rank-one eigenvalue replacement 2->2+tau for arbitrary real tau plus any symmetric dense ||T||op<=0.01 remains in the target and has density cap <=13.58170198712074.

partner_application.dependence_note: No independence between completed square and Schur remainder is used.

remaining_implication: From bare s3(A)>=1, extract an original-coordinate cut with two robust shifted singular reserves plus collective tail and a low-leverage row projection containing the added-direction footprints, or force a paid hub/physical-pair/physical-triple/scalar-pivot exit. High-leverage footprints are the concentrated alternative and must not be hidden by rotating the product source.
